mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. Overcast skies hang over the Verona Public Library with temperatures at 34 degrees, feeling like 23 degrees with the wind chill. A Full Moon lights up the sky tonight and the space station passes overhead, though heavy cloud cover will block it from view.

In city news, municipal offices and the recycling center will close Thursday, November 26th, and Friday, November 27th, for Thanksgiving, delaying Thursday trash pickup to Friday. Additionally, Public Works is evaluating space needs to expand facility capacity and residential disposal areas to support community growth.

Local activities include Yoga at Insight Wellness happening today. Tomorrow, you can check out trivia at Hop Haus Brewing, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead to Black Friday on November 27th, Wisconsin Brewing Company is celebrating 50 years of craft brewing.

In police news, on Friday, November 6th, officers and fire personnel responded to a business in the 500 block of West Verona Avenue for a woman passed out in a vehicle. Firefighters broke a window to reach her, and she was subsequently arrested for O W I.
Culver's of Verona is open until 10:00 PM today featuring Butter Pecan as the Flavor of the Day, with OREO REESE'S Cheesecake on deck for tomorrow.
